name: drawstop
title: Drawstop
description: A concert organist's theme built like the console's stop jamb: a walnut band with the name inlaid in ivory, and every date led by a turned ivory drawknob engraved with its status, pushed in and engraved red when sold out, on ebony black or bone white.

tokens.--font-caps: engraved roman capitals: the name, menu, titles, place names, dates and knob engraving
tokens.--font-text: old-style text and italic: body, intro lines, venues, guests
tokens.--text-s: small print: guests and the footer
tokens.--text-l: intro lines, menu, dates, section headings, small-capital links
tokens.--text-xl: place names in the list and post titles
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of capitals and small capitals
tokens.--color-bg: page background: ebony (default) or cool bone white (light scheme)
tokens.--color-text: main text: ivory on ebony, ebony on bone
tokens.--color-muted: quieter text: dates, venues, guests, intro lines, pagination
tokens.--color-accent: links, hovered names and titles, focus ring on the page
tokens.--color-rule: hairlines between dates, posts and table rows
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--color-walnut: walnut of the header and footer band and the jamb strip, the quote rule, text selection
tokens.--color-walnut-deep: dark edge of the band and jamb, bushing round a pushed-in knob, hovered name plate
tokens.--color-grain: dark lines of the walnut grain
tokens.--color-figure: pale lines of the grain, the highlight on the jamb edge and round a pushed-in knob
tokens.--color-inlay: ivory on walnut: the name and its stringing, current menu item, footer links, focus ring on walnut, skip link
tokens.--color-inlay-muted: quieter ivory on walnut: menu, footer labels and notes, outer stringing line
tokens.--color-ivory: face of the drawknobs, the plate over the dates, the knob before section headings
tokens.--color-ivory-shade: turned shading on the lower side of each knob face, the sunken rim of a pushed-in knob
tokens.--color-engrave: black engraving on knobs and plate, skip link text
tokens.--color-coupler: coupler red: engraving on a sold-out knob, nowhere else
tokens.--color-shank: dark collar and drawn shank of each knob, ring round heading knobs
tokens.--color-shadow: shadow a drawn knob casts, hollow round a pushed-in one
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a text column
tokens.--gutter: space at the page's left and right edge
tokens.--jamb: width of the walnut jamb strip beside the list
tokens.--knob: diameter of a drawknob (a fifth larger on a date's own page)
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of code blocks and images
